in_marathi.name: Vanshik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vanshik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vansh', which means 'lineage', 'descent' or 'ancestry'. The name 'Vanshik' signifies a person belonging to a sacred lineage or one who upholds the family traditions and values. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and is often given to boys to instill a sense of pride in their heritage and spiritual values.
